title: Saudi Arabian Caramelized Omelette
description: A rich and flavorful omelette dish inspired by the traditional cuisine of Saudi Arabia, featuring caramelized onions and spices.

ingredients.name: Caramelized Onions
ingredients.notes: Cooked to a deep golden brown

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: In a small pan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the caramelized onions and cook for 1 minute.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites until frothy.
Add the Saudi Arabian spice blend to the egg whites and mix well.
Pour the egg white mixture over the onions in the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the eggs are set.
Fold the omelette in half and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
